platform.title: IBM Z / LinuxONE (IBM 6 IFLs)
platform.host_platform: IBM 6 IFLs (Integrated Facility for Linux - 6 Physical Cores)

services.name: APIgator (4 Pods)
services.plain_role: Primary API gateway handling inbound request validation, policy evaluation, hashing & token decryption.

services.name: Meta Data Worker (1 Pod)
services.plain_role: Generates encryption keys in HashiCorp Vault used to construct encrypted values.

services.name: Redis Cache (1 Pod)
services.plain_role: High-speed token, session, and policy cache layer ensuring sub-millisecond lookup latency.

services.name: HashiCorp Vault (1 Pod)
services.plain_role: Secure key management service providing encryption keys for Pseudonymise and Reconstruct jobs.

ibm_architectural_features.desc: Guaranteed Kubernetes resource requests across 7 pods equal 5.80 vCPU cores, fitting strictly within 6 physical IFL cores with zero over-commitment.
Custom IBM OpenJ9 Generational Concurrent GC policy (-Xgcpolicy:gencon) and 75% container heap memory allocation (-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0) optimized for s390x hardware memory access patterns.
Direct z/Architecture hardware instruction acceleration for SHA-256 hashing and AES tokenization privacy transforms.
Pod requests match limits for critical microservices, preventing host noisy-neighbor throttling.

config.title: DataMasking Job
config.plain_concept: DataMasking converts sensitive text into irreversible hash values using cryptographic hashing algorithms. It secures data at rest and in transit.
config.safe_reason: 2,500 RPS is 60-Minute Soak Verified Safe with P95 latency at 56.33ms (well under 100ms SLA limit) and 0.0% error rate. 2,600 and 2,700 RPS passed 1m ramp tests and are pending 60m soak verification.

config.title: Restrict Job
config.plain_concept: Restrict evaluates incoming requestor identities, roles, and contextual policies to dynamically grant or block data access.
config.safe_reason: 2,000 RPS is 60-Minute Soak Verified Safe with P95 latency at 48.40ms and 0.0% error rate. 2,200 and 2,500 RPS passed 5m hold runs.

config.title: Pseudonymise Job
config.plain_concept: Pseudonymise replaces sensitive identifiers with reversible tokens. Authorized users can later detokenize data.
config.safe_reason: 1,500 RPS is 60-Minute Soak Verified Safe with P95 latency at 38.48ms (well under 100ms SLA limit) and 0.0% error rate across 11.01 Million benchmark requests.

config.title: Reconstruct Job
config.plain_concept: Reconstruct validates policy permissions and detokenizes encrypted tokens back to plain text for authorized requestors.
config.safe_reason: 1,500 RPS is 60-Minute Soak Verified Safe with P95 latency at 53.65ms and 0.0% error rate across 10.88 Million HTTP requests. 1,600 RPS passed 1m ramp tests (70.24ms P95) and is pending 60m soak verification.
